Sinch NCR._comment: NCR site 'Sinch' (city NCR). Logics from the client sheet + the two sample weeks. Bread is tawa roti daily (constant). Rice split: flavour rice Mon/Wed, white rice (the const 'white_rice' slot) Tue/Thu/Fri — so exactly one carb each day and never both. Raita (curd_side) Mon/Fri only; welcome drink Tue/Thu only; starter Wednesday only and chaats only (the last two rules are inert until a starter category, count 1, is added to this counter in the editor). The Tue/Wed/Thu drink in the sample 'Curd Prep' row is not a curd_side dish and is out of clean scope.

rules._comment: Chicken three times a week (Mon/Wed/Fri); egg curry twice a week (Tue/Thu).
rules.name: sinchncr_nonveg_by_weekday

rules._comment: Paneer once a week (in the veg gravy).
rules.name: sinchncr_paneer_1x

rules._comment: Flavour rice only Mon and Wed.
rules.name: sinchncr_flavour_rice_mon_wed

rules._comment: White rice only when there is no flavour rice: Tue/Thu/Fri. (white_rice is the const steamed-rice slot.)
rules.name: sinchncr_white_rice_tue_thu_fri

rules._comment: Raita served only on Monday and Friday.
rules.name: sinchncr_raita_mon_fri

rules._comment: Welcome drink only on Tuesday and Thursday.
rules.name: sinchncr_welcome_drink_tue_thu

rules._comment: Starter is served only on Wednesday. Inert until a starter slot is added to this counter (slot_count 0 => no cells to restrict); it activates the moment the editor gives the counter a starter category.
rules.name: sinchncr_starter_wed_only

rules._comment: The Wednesday starter must be a chaat (only chaats to be served). NCR's chaat starters are sub_category 'chaat_/_tikki' (dhokla, kachori, samosa_chaat) — only 3 today, so add more chaat starters if a 4th consecutive week is needed. Inactive until the starter slot exists (min_slot_count gate).
rules.name: sinchncr_starter_chaats_only
